description: This file is a shell script implementing tests for git push porcelain output behavior, including setup procedures for repositories, various push scenarios, and output validation. It primarily contains functions to create commits, configure repositories, and run test cases to verify Git operations with different options.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns each commit's oid to a variable named after provided parameters, avoiding subshell calls to preserve variable scope.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Extracts an abbreviated version of a given commit oid.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats command output to replace commit OIDs and URLs with placeholders for stable, user-friendly output.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Processes expectation output, trimming prompts and extraneous characters, and saves to a file.

methods.name: create_upstream_template
methods.description: Initializes a bare upstream template repository, creates commits, and pushes them to set up a reference base.

methods.name: setup_upstream
methods.description: Configures and clones an upstream repository, optionally enabling HTTP receive-pack.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up both upstream and working directory repositories, with references and URL configurations.

methods.name: run_git_push_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Runs a series of push tests with --porcelain, including success, rejection, atomic, and force scenarios, validating output and repository states.

methods.name: run_git_push_dry_run_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Performs dry-run push tests with --porcelain, verifying output consistency under various push options.
